Class UserService

java.lang.Object
service.UserService
public class UserService extends Object
Validates user insertion and coordinates user deletion with friendship cleanup. Repositories perform their own persistence. Multi-repository operations are sequential and have no service-level rollback.

  • Method Details

    • addUser

      public void addUser(User user)
      Validates the supplied user, then delegates insertion to the user repository. A FILE repository may validate the user again. Validation failure prevents the insertion call; persistence and duplicate handling belong to the repository.
      Parameters:
      user - the user accepted by the configured validator and repository
      Throws:
      ValidationException - if validation rejects the user
      IllegalArgumentException - if repository argument or duplicate checks fail
      RepositoryException - if repository persistence fails
      UnsupportedOperationException - if insertion is not implemented

    • deleteUser

      public void deleteUser(Long id)
      Checks that a user exists, deletes each incident friendship, then deletes the user. A failure propagates immediately; earlier successful deletions are not undone and the user may remain after partial friendship cleanup.
      Parameters:
      id - the existing user identifier; null is absent in MEMORY and FILE
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if the user is absent or a delegated deletion rejects an ID
      RepositoryException - if delegated persistence fails
      UnsupportedOperationException - if a delegated operation is not implemented
